resources.string: Terms & Privacy Policy
Your account is a SWARM wallet
SWARM Messenger has no phone numbers. Your account comes from a wallet recovery phrase: 24 words that open both your messages and your SWARM wallet.
Create a new wallet
I have a recovery phrase
Write down these 24 words

They are the only way back into this account and its wallet, on this phone or any other. Anyone who has them has both. Write them on paper, in this order, and keep them safe. SWARM cannot recover them for you, and they will not be shown again.
I have written these 24 words down
Enter your recovery phrase
The 24 words of your SWARM wallet, in order, separated by spaces. The same words always give the same account.
